claim_summary.detail: The report's summary line is the Headline paragraph naming 28,887 incumbent review rows, 331 human `sn edit` corrections, 659 deterministic quarantines, 61 WEST-audited name repairs, <200 independent docs-acceptability items and 16,282 incumbent docs reviews. [human_edit.coverage] returned {'names': 331} and [snc.ops] returned human_edit c=339 — the two figures the report's table row 1 states ('339 ops, 337 distinct from->to pairs, 331 names': 339 ops here, 331 names via HAS_INTERNAL_CHANGE). CLAIM 3.detail: Re-ran west_join.py from the run directory. Output: 'worklist rejected(part1): 51 proposed: 51 splits: 10' (51+10=61 ids) and '[west.exist] found=61 of 61' — every one of the 61 repaired/rejected identities exists in the graph, all name_stage=accepted, validation_status=valid, matching the report's table row 4 ('61 repairs = 51 renames + 10 splits') and its calibration-gap note that all 61 sit accepted/valid. [west.reviews] returned docs 483 / name 236 reviews over 61 names, matching the row's '236 name-axis, 483 docs-axis'. Reproduced.
CLAIM 3.finding: 61 WEST-audited name repairs (51 renames + 10 splits) are an independent name-correctness label source, each rejected name carrying incumbent reviews

CLAIM_SUMMARY.detail: The report's summary line is the Headline paragraph: 'The usable independently-labelled set is real but far smaller than the incumbent's 28,887 review rows, and it is concentrated on the negative side. Three cohorts are immediately computable as paired AUC input: 331 human `sn edit` corrections, 659 deterministic quarantines, and 61 WEST-audited name repairs. The binding weakness is documentation-acceptability: everything independent of the incumbent totals well under 200 items there, against 16,282 incumbent docs reviews.' Every figure it quotes is carried by the table beneath it: 28,887 StandardNameReview rows (§0 'snr.count', table row citing it), 331 (row 1 count '331 names'), 659 (row 2 count '659 names'), 61 (row 4 count '61 repairs'), 16,282 incumbent docs reviews (§0 'docs 16,282 rows'), and the docs-axis independence '<200' (row 2 docs overlap 155, row 1 docs overlap 131). All agree; the three cohort figures were independently reproduced in CLAIM 1-3.
